title: The fibre product of two complete Noetherian local rings over a common quotient is complete Noetherian local

standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of Cohen rings with prescribed residue field and the Cohen structure theorem
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Definition \ref{algebra-definition-cohen-ring}, Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-cohen-rings-exist}, and Algebra, Theorem \ref{algebra-theorem-cohen-structure-theorem}, cited at proof lines 9828-9837
standard_prerequisites.use: Provide the power series presentation of the common quotient and the characteristic split.

standard_prerequisites.name: Power series rings over a Cohen ring are formally smooth, and continuous maps lift along surjections of complete local rings
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Lemma \ref{lemma-power-series-ring-over-Cohen-fs} and Lemma \ref{lemma-lift-continuous}, cited at proof lines 9840-9842
standard_prerequisites.use: Lift the surjections onto the common quotient to maps from the power series ring.

core_obligations: Split according to the characteristic of the residue field and choose the Cohen ring or the residue field itself (proof lines 9828-9832).
Apply the Cohen structure theorem to present the common quotient as a quotient of a power series ring (proof lines 9833-9837).
Lift the two surjections to maps from that power series ring (proof lines 9838-9842).
Choose generators of the two kernels and write down a surjection from a power series ring in the base variables and the two families of generators onto the fibre product (proof lines 9843-9852).
Conclude that the fibre product is complete as a quotient of a complete local ring (proof lines 9852-9853).
proof_roadmap: Choose the Cohen ring and the presentation of the quotient (proof lines 9828-9837).
Present the fibre product and conclude completeness (proof lines 9843-9853).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the fibre product of two surjections of complete Noetherian local rings over a common quotient is again a complete Noetherian local ring. The proof builds an explicit presentation: it chooses a Cohen ring or the residue field itself according to the characteristic, uses the Cohen structure theorem to write the quotient as a quotient of a power series ring, lifts the two surjections to that power series ring using formal smoothness of power series rings over a Cohen ring and the lifting of continuous maps, and then presents the fibre product as a quotient of a power series ring in the variables of the base together with generators of the two kernels. Being a quotient of a complete local ring makes the fibre product complete.
